title.title: From scale symmetry to local conformal symmetry in 4D
title.subtitle: Claim: under stated axioms, a scale-invariant 4D QFT has a symmetric, conserved, traceless stress tensor

beats.text: Four hypotheses on a scale-invariant four-dimensional quantum field theory
Claim: under them the stress tensor improves to a symmetric, conserved, traceless one
That gives local conformal Ward identities, not a global conformal action

achievement.label: Scale implies conformal invariance (2D: Polchinski 1988)
achievement.context: Before: perturbative arguments (2012) and a nonperturbative one under assumptions (2015)
achievement.note: Conditional on a strong axiomatic framework; not the physics question

verify.ourCheck: We read the papers' claims and caveats; we did not referee them

sources.quote: Polchinski (1988) proved scale implies conformal in 2D

plain: If a quantum theory looks the same at every zoom level, does it also keep angles? Yes, under strong axioms

steps: Angle symmetry follows if the stress tensor can be made traceless
Under the axioms, improve the stress tensor so its trace vanishes
Its charges stay the same, so the symmetry is unbroken

voice.text: Four strong hypotheses on a scale-invariant quantum field theory in four dimensions.
Under them, the stress tensor improves to a traceless one, with the same charges.
Claimed, conditionally: local conformal symmetry follows.
